---
title: "Tutorials"
---

Hands-on materials for the summer school. Each tutorial is self-contained in
its own folder in the
[repository](https://github.com/stefanradev93/sbi4cogsci/tree/main/tutorials)
and states its **own** requirements and a single run command in its README —
there is no global environment and no required toolchain.
